item.title: Former BJP MLA Sanchita Mohanty dies at 67
item.description: Former BJP MLA Sanchita Mohanty dies at 67 Senior BJP leader and former MLA Sanchita Mohanty died at her residence here on Friday following a brief illness, family sources said.Sixty-seven-year-old Mohanty was elected to the Odisha Assembly from the Korei constituency in 2004.
